Browse equipment, materials, and supplies. Each item page brings together its documented stats, crafting recipes, merchant offers, and loot references.

The groups below are browsing aids. Useful cross-categories connect tools, ingredients, remedies, and other overlapping uses without copying the item article. Consumables include food that may cause sickness, not just safe food.

A missing stat or acquisition method is unknown. A source entry alone does not prove that the item is obtainable in your build.
